electroencephalogram.definition: n. a graphical record of electrical activity of the brain; produced by an electroencephalograph
electroencephalogram.translation:
[计] 脑电波记录
[医] 脑[动]电[流]图

electroencephalograms.definition:
plural of electroencephalogram
n. a graphical record of electrical activity of the brain; produced by an electroencephalograph
electroencephalograms.translation:
(electroencephalogram 的复数) [计] 脑电波记录
[医] 脑[动]电[流]图

electroencephalograph.definition: n. medical instrument that records electric currents generated by the brain
electroencephalograph.translation: n. [医]脑电描记器,脑电图仪

electroencephalographer.translation: n. 脑电图技师；脑电图仪操作人员

electroencephalographic.definition: a of or relating to an electroencephalograph
electroencephalographic.translation: a. [医]脑电图仪的, 脑电描记器的,脑电图学的

electroencephalography.translation:
n. 脑电图记录, 脑电图
[计] 脑电图显示, 脑电图描记术

electroencephaloscope.translation: 脑电检查仪; 脑电镜

electroendosmosis.translation: [化] 电内渗; 电内渗现象

electroengineering.translation: n. 电气工程,电机工程,电工学, 电工技术

electroexplosive.translation: 电控引爆器; 电起爆炸药

electroextraction.translation: 电解提取法; 电解萃取
